Event Ahead: The U.A. Sports Festival.name: Event Ahead: The U.A. Sports Festival

effects.instruction: Narrator only: The U.A. Sports Festival is on Tuesday, April 23. Unless the player asks to skip, story time never moves past that date before it is played: no summary of days, recovery or waiting carries the story beyond it. If the player is hurt or away, the day still comes and they are brought into it, healed and cleared to take part fully.
